digest.component_or_area: review-bot deploy and persistent tickets clone
propositions: The review-bot's persistent tickets clone on EBS-backed external volume is not refreshed on redeploy because the entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, allowing divergent history to persist
The ensure-tickets script does not fetch, classify ancestry, or reset divergent persistent clones, and must be added to autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS to enable automatic deployment of ensure-script changes

A fetch with explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets must be performed before convergence, with best-effort success (preserve local tip and emit warning if credentials absent or origin unreachable) to avoid aborting already-cast votes

Pre-epoch local clones must adopt the pinned newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commit only when pre-fetch local tip is ancestor of readable prior remote tip, preserving the union safety invariant and rejecting all ahead/diverged/corrupt states with operator warnings
The ensure script must preserve execution outside the PAT block and maintain best-effort vote safety during artifact-write failures
